name: Daniel Kojo Megbenu
title: DevOps | Cloud Engineer
tagline: 5+ years architecting, automating and securing enterprise infrastructure across hybrid and cloud-native environments. Kubernetes, Terraform and AWS, with security and observability built into every pipeline.
summary: Cloud and DevOps engineer with 5+ years architecting, automating and securing enterprise infrastructure across hybrid and cloud-native environments. Expert in Terraform, Ansible and CloudFormation, Kubernetes, and CI/CD with Jenkins and GitOps.
story: I started as a **Linux systems administrator at the Ghana Revenue Authority**, keeping 100+ servers behind national tax platforms running around the clock, and automating the routine work with Bash and Python.

Since then I have designed **CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes and OpenShift platforms, and Terraform-built AWS infrastructure** for teams in London and the United States, with DevSecOps scanning and compliance against HIPAA, SOC 2 and CIS benchmarks built in.

I mentor teams and **bridge development, operations and security** to raise DevOps maturity. I also bring a finance background: an MSc in Accounting and Finance and experience supporting enterprise financial platforms.
